summary: A decision can become much more intense once getting your way starts feeling tied to proving that nobody else gets to control you.
body: A decision can become much more intense once getting your way starts feeling tied to proving that nobody else gets to control you. When the Sun conjoins Pluto, identity and power fuse, concentrating ambition, desire, fear, and control around whatever feels most consequential. This can give you the nerve to confront something you have avoided for too long, but it can also turn a solvable disagreement into a referendum on who has the upper hand. Notice when the outcome has stopped being the point. Power is more useful when it changes the situation, not just who wins the standoff.
